sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 3x to 6x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK and MATK by 120% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK buff limit by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases MATK buff limit by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 20 Cost.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 20.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 80. Blinds for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
[Additional Unison Effect] Decreases the Unison gauge of all enemies by 10
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
